name: XAU_SIMPLE_INDEPENDENT_FAMILIES_V1
purpose: Overnight screen of simple XAU M5 phenomenon families after closure of the bar_range_atr directional final-OOS candidate. This is fresh discovery/confirmation on 2024/2025 only, not a rescue of the failed candidate.
state_definition: 2024-fitted feature quintiles, frozen into 2025; feature quintile alone and feature quintile x frozen 4-hour server block
independence_rule: Report at most one representative per family/outcome/horizon/direction cluster; prefer larger confirmation sample, then lower confirmation q, then larger retained effect. Do not count correlated quintile/hour variants as independent candidates.
overnight_constraints: Use the existing clean Phase I-B XAUUSD M5 2024/2025 dataset.
No MT5 process, exporter, HCC access, network data acquisition or owner interaction.
No 2026 file may be opened or inspected.
No PnL, stop, target, sizing, Challenge Lab or post-hoc threshold optimization.
Do not reuse bar_range_atr or variants of the failed Phase I-F candidate.
A survivor is only a new phenomenon candidate and must receive a separate frozen robustness/confirmation step before any protected OOS.
